evals.prompt: 我第一次用这个 skill,帮我准备环境分析 LAMMPS 轨迹
evals.expected_output: 运行 bootstrap_env.py;报告 .venv 就绪或已存在(幂等);输出环境路径
assertions: Calls bootstrap_env.py (or explains that .venv/.ready already exists)
Mentions the .venv/.ready idempotency marker
Checks whether the environment exists before rebuilding
Reports the ready state (created date / python version)

evals.prompt: run2 目录有 dump.lammpstrj 和 data.lammps(MACE 跑的 300 K 水),帮我算 O-O 的 RDF 和配位数,画图
evals.expected_output: l2_rdf_cn.py 运行,输出 O-O_rdf.csv 与 rdf_cn.png,结论含配位数
assertions: Selects scripts/l2_rdf_cn.py
Passes --pairs O:O (or resolves O through the type map) and --cn-cut 3.5
Checks the input files exist before running
Relays the CONCLUSION line with a CN value verbatim

evals.prompt: 帮我算水的扩散系数。轨迹是 MACE-MD,每 1000 步 dump 一次,MD 步长 0.5 fs
evals.expected_output: 先 l1_traj_prep(unwrap)再 l3_msd;dt 从 TIMESTEP 差推算;输出 3D 与 xy 的 D
assertions: Recognizes MSD needs unwrapping first: runs l1_traj_prep before l3_msd (or uses an existing *_uw.dump)
Derives dt_fs from dump TIMESTEP gaps x 0.5 fs rather than hardcoding a value
Uses the 20%-90% fit window (or explains its choice)
Reports D in cm^2/s for both 3d and xy components

evals.prompt: 把集群 167 上 run2 的 dump.lammpstrj 拉下来,然后做密度分析看水层有几层
evals.expected_output: 先经 cluster-connect pull,再本地 l2_density --layers;层数来自显著局部极小
assertions: Uses cluster-connect to pull the trajectory (does not analyse remotely)
Runs l2_density.py locally with --layers
Reports the number of layers from local-minimum splitting
Does not execute the analysis on the cluster

evals.prompt: 看下 log.lammps,体系平衡了没?温度能量什么水平
evals.expected_output: l1_log_parse.py 运行;漂移判据 + 分段均值 ± σ;明确给出平衡/未平衡判定
assertions: Selects scripts/l1_log_parse.py
Uses block averaging (segmented means with std) and a drift criterion
Outputs block means with uncertainty
Does not claim 'equilibrated' when the drift criterion fails
